name: Gaza
what: War technically under ceasefire, but violence continues
when: War since Oct 7, 2023; ceasefire since Oct 10, 2025
how: Over 1,300 people killed since the "ceasefire" began; disarmament and reconstruction stalled
current: Israeli airstrikes continue in Gaza despite the October 2025 cease‑fire, with the latest attack on Nasser Hospital’s intensive‑care unit on 12 Nov 2026 killing at least six people. The conflict has claimed over 70,000 Palestinian civilians and fighters since the Oct 7 2023 Hamas assault, and health officials report roughly 600 additional deaths since the cease‑fire began. The humanitarian situation remains dire, with most of Gaza’s population displaced in tent camps and massive rubble covering the territory.

name: Korean peninsula

what: Nuclear and missile buildup, with no active dialogue

current: Tensions on the Korean Peninsula have risen after land‑mine explosions on the western DMZ injured three South Korean soldiers, reviving a decades‑old border dispute. Meanwhile, South Korea and the United States concluded joint “Hoguk” drills in late October, and analysts warn that any conflict could cost trillions given Seoul’s semiconductor dominance.
